name: The five sheaths (pañca-kośa) as defined in Taittirīya Upaniṣad 2.1-2.5

names.name: pañca ātmānaḥ (five selves) — annamaya, prāṇamaya, manomaya, vijñānamaya, ānandamaya

definitions.definition: Five selves, each "made of" (-maya) something, each person-shaped, each within the previous and filling it, with the refrain "tasyaiṣa eva śārīra ātmā yaḥ pūrvasya" (its embodied self is this very one, the one of the former; the construal is disputed): the self made of the essence of food (2.1.1); of breath (head prāṇa, wings vyāna and apāna, self ākāśa, support earth; 2.2.1); of mind (head yajus, wings ṛc and sāman, self ādeśa, support Atharvāṅgiras; 2.3.1); of understanding (head śraddhā, wings ṛta and satya, self yoga, support mahas; 2.4.1); of bliss (head priya, wings moda and pramoda, self ānanda, support brahman; 2.5.1). The knower, departing, approaches all five (2.8.5, 3.10.5). The word kośa does not occur in the text.

relations.note: Bhṛgu's identifications of brahman (3.2-3.6) follow the same five names in the same order.

checks.note: Corrected by J: Definition: "the later being the embodied self of the earlier" replaced by the text's refrain with its construal marked as disputed (see teachings 2.3.1-2.6.1).

definitions.definition: Bhṛgu, told to seek that from which beings are born, by which they live and into which they enter, knows brahman as food, then breath, then mind, then understanding, then bliss; after each he is told to seek by tapas; the sequence ends with the vidyā established in the highest space.

definitions.definition: Human bliss at its best, then a hundredfold ascent through gandharvas, fathers, gods, Indra, Bṛhaspati and Prajāpati to the bliss of brahman; each step is also the bliss of a learned man untouched by desire.

checks.note: Entity read against the teachings it rests on and their segments: faithful; level not raised by J.

definitions.definition: From the self space, from space wind, then fire, water, earth, plants, food, the person; also (2.6.1) the one who desired to be many performed tapas, created all and entered it.

checks.note: Entity read against the teachings it rests on and their segments: faithful; level not raised by J.
